notes.title: Updated to ver1.43
notes.notes:
→ver1.43
・The speed is now maintained without having to press the directional key when touching the horizontal spring.
・Fixed a problem with beach balls penetrating and breaking rock blocks.
・Fixed some images that were not displayed when porting some Switch version processes.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.42.
notes.notes:
→ver1.42
・I tried to display the magic description when you get that magic for the first time since you started the game.
・Windows 8 and earlier were removed from the list of operating environments because the development environment has changed.

The environment at hand has returned somewhat when the development machine broke down and we got a new machine, so we will respond again if the fixes since ver 1.41 are out of order.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.41a.
notes.notes:
→ver1.41a
The behavior of the beach ball breaking blocks was different from the previous version.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.41
notes.notes:
→ver1.41
Fixed a bug that some images were not displayed after updating to ver1.40.

notes.title: Version 1.40 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.40 Update
・While working to port the game for the Nintendo Switch, several scenes have been improve and are now included in this update. We feel that the quality of the graphics has been upgraded♪ 

・Several technical issues have been fixed.
-- While tests are made on this build, we would appreciate it if you could contact us if you find anything unusual.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.33.
notes.notes:
→ver1.33
Stick input thresholds have been adjusted. The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The shallow left/right input is for walking, and the large left/right input is for running.
Basically, the game uses a dash, so the game is adjusted to run if the input is normal without worrying about it.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.32
notes.notes:
Mainly minor fixes and adjustments.
When moving with the stick, a slight up input will cause the user to enter the door.
We are planning to ease the input.

→Ver. 1.31
When jumping from a ladder, it now takes a little time before the ladder grabs you again.

→ver1.32
Adjusted the direction of the 6W boss.

notes.title: Updated to ver1.30
notes.notes:
→ver 1.30
When the feet leave the ground, there is a small amount of time to accept a jump.
During this time, air bounces were given priority, but this has been corrected so that jumps will now occur.

Fixed a phenomenon in which some enemies would not be drawn for a moment.

Other internal changes have been made.

notes.title: Update Information (210721)
notes.notes:
